info.title: Queue OpenAPI for fal-ai/elevenlabs/sound-effects/v2
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the fal-ai/elevenlabs/sound-effects/v2 queue.

x-fal-metadata.about:
ElevenLabs Sound Effects Generation. V2

Turn text into sound effects for videos, voice-overs or video games using
state-of-the-art sound generation technology.

prompt_influence.title: Prompt Influence
prompt_influence.description: How closely to follow the prompt (0-1). Higher values mean less variation.

output_format.title: Output Format
output_format.description: Output format of the generated audio. Formatted as codec_sample_rate_bitrate.

text.title: Text
examples: Spacious braam suitable for high-impact movie trailer moments
A gentle wind chime tinkling in a soft breeze
text.description: The text describing the sound effect to generate

duration_seconds.title: Duration Seconds
duration_seconds.description: Duration in seconds (0.5-22). If None, optimal duration will be determined from prompt.

loop.title: Loop
loop.description: Whether to create a sound effect that loops smoothly.

audio.description: The generated sound effect audio file in MP3 format

ElevenlabsSoundEffectsV2Output.title: SoundEffectOutput
ElevenlabsSoundEffectsV2Output.description: Output format for generated sound effects

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The mime type of the file.

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
